name: Glim
author: Erin Carter
description: A dark meadow at night: true near-black with the faintest vertical ground gradient, scattered with sparse hash-grid fireflies that stay invisible until they flash. Each flash is a soft additive point with a fast attack and a long slow decay, tinted by hashing into a warm blend of two palette colours, and each spark drifts a few pixels on a slow Lissajous wobble so the field shimmers indefinitely with no visible seam.

params.label: Blink rate
params.effect: Multiplies every firefly's hash-timed flash frequency; higher means shorter waits and more simultaneous blinks.

params.label: Afterglow
params.effect: Stretches the slow decay tail of each flash; low gives crisp blinks, high leaves fading embers hanging in the dark.

params.label: Fly size
params.effect: Glow-core radius of each firefly in CSS pixels; the soft halo scales with it.

params.label: Spread
params.effect: Hash-grid cell size in CSS pixels; smaller packs more fireflies into the meadow, larger thins the swarm to rare lonely sparks.
